Card Components in CSS & Tailwind | Uiverse

name: Uiverse
summary: Community library of 7,000+ free open-source UI elements to copy as HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React or Figma.
description: Community-made UI elements — buttons, loaders, cards, checkboxes, toggle switches, inputs, forms and tooltips — with source you copy as HTML/CSS, Tailwind or React, or paste into Figma. Everything is free for personal and commercial use; browse by tag, type or use case, follow creator profiles, take part in challenges and read the blog. The whole library is also published on GitHub as uiverse-io/galaxy.
contains: copy as HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React, or paste into Figma
